name: Example Cell
description: Reference implementation of a plug-and-play cell type

_discovery.describe: Reference implementation demonstrating the plug-and-play cell type architecture. Shows minimal required structure for a functional cell: type.json definition, backend scripts, frontend View.vue, and documentation. Includes example initial_data, refs, and properties_schema. Perfect starting point for creating new cell types. Instant execution, no external dependencies. Use as template when building new cells.
